name: expo-moq-webtransport
description: Native WebTransport bridge for Expo/React Native with MoQT draft-16 subprotocol negotiation

scripts.test:runtime: rm -rf .runtime-test && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && mkdir -p .runtime-test/node_modules/expo-modules-core && printf '%s\n' 'exports.requireNativeModule = () => { throw new Error("native module should not be loaded in mock test"); };' > .runtime-test/node_modules/expo-modules-core/index.js && node .runtime-test/test/runtime.test.js
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:types && npm run test:runtime
